Army Ants
Death walks again in the flooded dark 
where an undead warlord watches 
with a magic eye!
A peaceful family of giant ants 
have unearthed far more than they 
intended: ancient warriors who resisted 
the Pale Queen long ago. Now, these 
warriors stir in the depths, cursed to 
live forever, yet trapped in death!
